verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own Authenticator import/export docs list imports from other authenticator apps: Google Authenticator via QR code, LastPass Authenticator JSON exports, and 2FAS backup files. That directly addresses moving tokens without re-enrolling each account. The evidence is short doc excerpts, though, so the bulk scope and any import limits are implied rather than spelled out. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk/multi-account import behavior and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful migration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand

citations.quote: Google Authenticator (QR code): Import from Google Authenticator using a QR code... LastPass (JSON): Import a LastPass Authenticator account export... 2FAS (.2fas): Import a 2FAS backup file
